## GET /admin-api/acme

`getAcme`

**The ACME server: directory, Issuing CA, profiles, EAB keys, accounts, certificates, host names, settings**

Everything /admin/acme draws. The absolute endpoints of this realm's ACME server (RFC 8555) with its directory; the ACME Issuing CA; the nine certificate profiles with what each needs and whether acme.allowedProfiles allows it, and the five never issued over ACME with the reason; the External Account Binding keys (no key material, paged by `credentialsPage`); the accounts (paged by `accountsPage`); the certificates issued over ACME (paged by `certificatesPage`); the host names registered on entries (paged by `hostNamesPage`); what development and product mode change; and the `acme.*` settings, which are written through POST /admin-api/config/set-many.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/cert-issuance` on the admin console.

The reply also carries `protocolEndpoints`: every endpoint of this family in the realm the call arrived in, as `{ name, methods, url }` (plus `route` for an HTTP endpoint, `transport` for a socket, and `registered: false` for a route the router no longer has).

Scope: `admin:read`.

**Parameters**

| Name | In | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `per` | query | integer |  | Rows per page, shared by every list in the reply. |
| `credentialsPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the EAB keys. |
| `accountsPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the accounts. |
| `certificatesPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the certificates. |
| `hostNamesPage` | query | integer |  | Which page of the entries with host names. |

## POST /admin-api/acme/add-host-name

`addAcmeHostName`

**Register a host name or address on an entry**

A dns or ip identifier is authorized for an ACME account only when it is registered on the entry the account is bound to; nothing is fetched to prove control of a name. The same registration serves EST and SCEP.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/acme` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hostName` | string | yes | A DNS name (a leading *. is a wildcard registered exactly so) or an IP address. |
| `identifier` | string | yes | The username of a person, or the identifier of an application, in this realm. |
| `kind` | one of `person`, `application` | yes | Whether the entry is a person (ou=users) or an application (ou=applications). |

**200**: The entry's host names as they now stand.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entryUri` | string |  |  |
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `hostNames` | list |  |  |
| `hostNames[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |

**400**: The operation was refused; `errors` says why and nothing changed.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entryUri` | string |  |  |
| `errors` | list |  |  |

| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |

## POST /admin-api/acme/create-eab

`createAcmeEab`

**Issue an External Account Binding key for a person or application (RFC 8555 section 7.3.4)**

Creates an EAB key for ONE entry in this realm and answers the key id and the HMAC key IN THE CLEAR, ONCE — the key is stored sealed on the entry and no operation reads it back. The ACME account a client registers with it is bound to that entry for life, which is the administrator's path in ACME: a key created here for somebody else's entry. The reply carries a ready-to-paste certbot line.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/acme` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `identifier` | string | yes | The username of a person, or the identifier of an application, in this realm. |
| `kind` | one of `person`, `application` | yes | Whether the entry is a person (ou=users) or an application (ou=applications). |
| `lifetimeS` | integer |  | How long it may wait before binding an account; at most acme.eabLifetimeS, which is also the default. |

**200**: The key id, the HMAC key (once), when it expires, the directory and a certbot line.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `alg` | string |  |  |
| `certbot` | string |  |  |

| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `expiresAt` | string, or number, or null |  |  |

## POST /admin-api/acme/deactivate-account

`deactivateAcmeAccount`

**Deactivate an ACME account (RFC 8555 section 7.3.6)**

The account authorizes nothing more — every request it signs is answered unauthorized — exactly as if the client had deactivated it itself. Certificates already issued are untouched; revoke them separately.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/acme` on the admin console.

## POST /admin-api/acme/delete-eab

`deleteAcmeEab`

**Delete an External Account Binding key**

Removes the key from its entry. An account it already bound keeps its binding; a key not yet used can no longer bind one.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/acme` on the admin console.

## GET /admin-api/acme/monitor

`getAcmeMonitor`

**What the ACME server has done in this realm**

Everything /admin/acme/monitor draws: requests, certificates issued and revoked, refusals, accounts bound, counts by operation, profile, principal, error code and HTTP status, and the most recent requests (paged by `page`). Per trust realm, merged across processes, and with no reset: the durable record is GET /admin-api/audit.

**Mirrors** `GET /admin/acme/monitor` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:read`.

## POST /admin-api/acme/remove-host-name

`removeAcmeHostName`

**Remove a registered host name from an entry**

Certificates already issued for it are untouched; a new order for it is refused rejectedIdentifier.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/acme` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `hostName` | string | yes | The registered name to remove. |
| `identifier` | string | yes | The username of a person, or the identifier of an application, in this realm. |
| `kind` | one of `person`, `application` | yes | Whether the entry is a person (ou=users) or an application (ou=applications). |

**200**: The entry's host names as they now stand.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entryUri` | string |  |  |
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `hostNames` | list |  |  |
| `hostNames[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |

**400**: The operation was refused; `errors` says why and nothing changed.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `entryUri` | string |  |  |
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `hostNames` | list |  |  |
| `hostNames[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |

## POST /admin-api/acme/revoke-certificate

`revokeAcmeCertificate`

**Revoke a certificate issued over ACME**

Puts the certificate on the ACME Issuing CA's CRL (/pki/crl/{realm}/acme) with the RFC 5280 reason given, and its OCSP responder answers revoked. The record on the entry is marked revoked.

**Mirrors** `POST /admin/acme` on the admin console.

Scope: `admin:write`.

**Request body**

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `reason` | one of `unspecified`, `keyCompromise`, `cACompromise`, `affiliationChanged`, `superseded`, `cessationOfOperation`, `certificateHold`, `privilegeWithdrawn`, `aACompromise` |  | The RFC 5280 reason; unspecified by default. |
| `serial` | string | yes | The serial number in hex. |

**200**: The serial that was revoked, and the reason.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |
| `reason` | string |  |  |
| `serialHex` | string |  |  |

**400**: The operation was refused; `errors` says why and nothing changed.

| Member | Type | Required | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|
| `errors` | list |  |  |
| `errors[]` | string |  |  |
| `message` | string |  |  |
| `ok` | boolean | yes |  |
| `reason` | string |  |  |
| `serialHex` | string |  |  |
